findings.summary: composerHasText treats any text after the prompt glyph as operator input. If the planner UI shows greyed placeholder or suggestion text in an empty composer, the notice would be held back on every pass. The held-back path throws and the item stays undelivered, so nothing is lost, but delivery could stall.

findings.summary: readPlannerAddress reads <board>/handoff/address-<name>.json, but nothing in pipeline-cli/src writes that file. Only the reader exists; the one other handoff writer is up.ts, for cli-bin.json. In production the socket branch is therefore never taken, and AC1 is met only against a test fixture. The composer guard still protects the reported case. Either add the writer, or document that the file is created by the planner's own hooks.
